claims: The Artemis II mission is scheduled for April 2026.
The Artemis II mission features a four-person crew.
Commander Reid Wiseman (NASA) is part of the Artemis II mission crew.
Pilot Victor Glover (NASA) is part of the Artemis II mission crew.
Mission Specialist Christina Koch (NASA) is part of the Artemis II mission crew.
Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen (Canadian Space Agency) is part of the Artemis II mission crew.
The Artemis II mission crew will perform the first crewed lunar flyby in over 50 years.
